title: Trailer Concrete Pump Towing, Chassis and Site Move
seoTitle: Trailer Concrete Pump Towing and Chassis | Pinjin Xingtai
description: Pinjin prints mass and L×W×H for each trailer row — Electric 15 is 450 kg and 1900×900×1200 mm; Electric 80 is 6000 kg. ACPA covers hitch and safety chain practice. Pinjin does not print a CDL class, axle rating or highway towing certificate. Quote the listed row, then inquire.

answerBlock.what: Pinjin trailer rows print mass and overall size. Examples: Electric 15 450 kg, 1900×900×1200 mm; Electric 20 900 kg, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm; Electric 30 1200 kg, 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm; Electric 40 2300 kg, 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Electric 80 6000 kg, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. ACPA training material discusses hitch, safety chain and not towing a charged pipeline. Pinjin does not print a CDL class, tyre load index, axle rating or highway homologation. Those are buyer and local-road facts, not Xingtai catalogue cells.
answerBlock.who: Buyers who will tow or crane a trailer pump between pours and need the printed mass and envelope, not an unpublished road-legal package.
factors: Use the printed kg and L×W×H for that model row only
ACPA: hitch and safety chain; do not tow a pressurised line
No published CDL, axle or highway certificate on Pinjin pages
Site skidding vs highway towing are different jobs — send both if you need a quote comment

faqs.question: Can I tow Electric 80 on a public road with a pickup?
faqs.answer: Electric 80 lists 6000 kg and 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Pinjin does not print a hitch class, CDL or highway towing certificate. Whether a pickup is legal is a local-road and vehicle-rating question, not a factory cell. Send the tractor or crane you actually have with the model slug.

faqs.question: Does ACPA tell me how to hitch a Pinjin chassis?
faqs.answer: ACPA training discusses hitch, safety chain and not moving a charged pipeline. It is not a Pinjin axle drawing. Use the printed mass. Inspect tyres, lights and pins as site practice — unpublished tyre SKUs are not listed as factory options on these product pages.

faqs.question: Is Electric 15 light enough to manhandle on a slab?
faqs.answer: Electric 15 lists 450 kg and 1900×900×1200 mm. That is catalogue mass, not a two-person lift rating. The mini / narrow-access article covers door width. Do not invent a factory ‘site-move kit’ that is not on the product page.
